items.title: NVIDIA Deja View: a 117M-parameter looped-transformer model for multi-view 3D geometry and camera poses, matches or beats models up to 10x larger on five benchmarks
items.summary: A single transformer block looped a chosen number of times turns photos from different angles into 3D geometry and camera positions; the loop count can be dialed to fit a compute budget. Paper (NeurIPS 2026 oral) and code are linked.

doubt.pushback: Repliers ask for accuracy-versus-FLOPs curves, since looping saves parameters but not compute, and for results on low-overlap views; no one reports reproducing it yet.

reception.summary: Mostly short praise for the size result plus technical questions on FLOPs, loop-count degradation and low-overlap scenes; no one reports running it.

items.title: Iris-Z: open 9B and 32B image model that generates images and depth together and beats task-specific depth models such as MoGe-3
items.summary: One backbone generates images plus depth, estimates depth and conditions generation on depth. Weights, code and a demo are released under Apache 2.0.

items.title: RoboDojo-RC: on real robot tasks the robot-specific Dream-1 scores 59% vs 57% for Fable 5.2, at about 40x lower cost per trial
items.summary: A real-robot benchmark thread across 120 Fable 5.2 runs with transcripts and videos: Dream-1 averages $0.15 and 1.4 minutes per trial against $5.93 and 4.5 minutes, while LLMs are reported gaining about 10 points a month on Tier 1.

doubt.pushback: Evaluators note Fable 5.2's API cannot drop earlier images, so it carried every image in context; the trend extrapolation to early 2027 is a projection.

items.title: vstack and veriserve: a method to verify coding-agent-written LLM inference engines, which surfaced 3 classes of RDMA and KV-cache bugs and 6 proposed fixes in production engines
items.summary: Pins specs by hash and checks model fidelity so coding agents cannot weaken verifiers; veriserve tracks physical KV pages with versioned tickets so a failed RDMA transfer cannot mix one user's cache into another's response.

doubt.pushback: Blog and code links were not opened by the sweep; counts of bugs are the lab's own.

items.title: RoboCap-10k: 10,000 hours of open egocentric work data with 3D head and hand tracking, released on Hugging Face via LeRobot
items.summary: Covers 21 industries across 5 continents with 619 paid real work tasks recorded on 6-camera, dual-IMU hardware, from GroundedSI.

items.title: Letta adds Meta Muse Ember to its FrontierMemory leaderboard: similar to Muse Wonder at a fraction of the cost for agent self-improvement through dreaming
items.summary: Leaderboard run of small models: Haiku 5.5 is best of the small ones and near Opus 5.5 quality at under a third of the cost per dream, GPT-6 Luna trails.

doubt.pushback: Leaderboard is run by the vendor on its own benchmark.

items.title: Cupola: coding agents on a Mac (Claude Code, Codex, T3 Code, OpenCode, Cursor) show up as chats on an iPhone, with live screen view over Wi-Fi and Tailscale
items.summary: Lets a user reply to agents, approve their requests and watch the Mac screen from a phone; built on trycua.

doubt.pushback: No repo or download link seen in the post text; very low engagement so far.
